label: Emailer
description: Manage transactional email templates and send system emails through SMTP.

instructions: Apply the bundled Supabase schema and Edge Function to the configured project.
Configure SMTP_HOST, SMTP_PORT, SMTP_SECURE, SMTP_USER, SMTP_PASSWORD, SMTP_FROM, and optional SMTP_REPLY_TO in the connector provider.
Install the Emailer source and dashboards with the deployed function URL.
checks: SMTP configuration is provided by the connector provider, not by integration answers.
Templates use data interpolation only; arbitrary JavaScript is not executed.
The connector schema stays private to anon and authenticated Supabase roles.
resources: Generated private CMS Emailer API key
Private emailer schema and Edge Function
review: Configure dedicated SMTP credentials in the provider environment with the minimum permissions available.
Call system sends through CMS functions or triggers rather than public pages.
Do not place sensitive data in template samples.
Add provider webhooks or bounce processing in a later integration version if delivery state must be authoritative.
ui.syncNote: This integration creates a CMS source backed by a Supabase Edge Function. Supabase stores templates and message audit rows; the SMTP provider sends email.
